- Operates the Zip Archive API through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI.
- Compresses one or more publicly accessible files into a ZIP archive.
- Extracts publicly accessible archives and returns extracted files through transit storage.

- Keeps credentials server-side through OOMOL, avoiding direct token handling.
